summary: MaterialDNA advertises bounded generation/persistence validation, but malformed plain tables can force unbounded scans and diagnostic allocation: validateKnownFields walks every supplied record key and emits one error per unknown field, while validateDenseArray walks every supplied entry before enforcing the 32/8-entry canonical limits. A hostile or corrupted oversized recipe can therefore consume work proportional to attacker-controlled table size before failing.
evidence: Inspected main@ae83c0ef470eb2e73d99be41fd3561ede30c40e1 MaterialDNA source and tests plus retained repair-count PR #353 exact head 10559afdce1a1854e7932522f6e78561736c8ed3; both retain the same unbounded validateKnownFields and validateDenseArray traversal behavior.

validateKnownFields iterates pairs(record) to exhaustion and appends a distinct diagnostic for every unknown field; closed schema records have small fixed legal shapes, so malformed extra fields currently remove the intended work/error bound.

validateDenseArray counts the full supplied table before checking count > maximum, so historyEvents/anomalyModifiers with arbitrarily many entries still require a full scan despite canonical maxima of 32 and 8.

Docs/MATERIAL_DNA_CONTRACT.md states recipe validation/freezing is bounded content-generation/persistence work and cites the 32-event/8-modifier caps, which malformed inputs can currently bypass as a work bound before rejection.

Repository PR/code search found no existing MaterialDNA malformed-input scan/error-budget lane. Existing #353 bounds repairCount exactness; the older percent-key grammar finding is a separate canonical alphabet issue.
No Roblox Studio or engine evidence is implicated; this is a source-only malformed-input/resource-boundary defect.

metadata.recommendedNext: After the trusted-history control recovery stabilizes ownership, add an explicit bounded preflight/early-rejection contract for closed records and capped arrays, preserve valid recipe/state/reference semantics and #353 safe-integer behavior, cap malformed diagnostic growth, and add deterministic over-budget regressions without a schema/version bump.
